simple.summary: אֲחִיחֻד (ʼĂchîychud) means Achichud , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 8 7.

definitions.full: H284. Achichud אֲחִיחֻד proper name, masculine (probably = אחיהוד q. v.) son of Ehud, a Benjamite 1Chr 8:7 .
